A01.name: A01:2025 - Broken Access Control
A01.desc: Checks for directory listing and exposures of sensitive files (.git, .env).

A02.name: A02:2025 - Security Misconfiguration
A02.desc: Analyzes security headers, server disclosures, and risky open ports.

A03.name: A03:2025 - Software Supply Chain Failures
A03.desc: Scans for outdated or vulnerable third-party frontend libraries.

A04.name: A04:2025 - Cryptographic Failures
A04.desc: Tests SSL/TLS configuration, certificate validity, and HTTPS usage.

A05.name: A05:2025 - Injection
A05.desc: Tests for SQL Injection and Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).

A06.name: A06:2025 - Insecure Design
A06.desc: Evaluates design flaws, including CORS policies and redirect patterns.

A07.name: A07:2025 - Authentication Failures
A07.desc: Identifies weak authentication mechanisms and missing rate limiting.

A08.name: A08:2025 - Software or Data Integrity Failures
A08.desc: Verifies Subresource Integrity (SRI) for external scripts.

A09.name: A09:2025 - Security Logging and Alerting Failures
A09.desc: Checks for publicly accessible log files and diagnostic endpoints.

A10.name: A10:2025 - Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions
A10.desc: Detects verbose error messages and debug information leaks.
